title: Overpriced Box of Horrible Tasting Snacks. It’s Like The ‘Snacks To Avoid’ Box.
text: Not Worth It.  The items we got, all tasted horrible.  We got Peach Cookies, which sound nice, but are way too overly sweet.  All the other items, YUCH!  The box is too expensive for what is actually provided as these seem like company freebies that are sent to this company and they package up, not trying anything, and whalla(!) we get to be the first!  Sorry guys but tastes were just not good.
label: negative
